name: Roaring River State Park Campgrounds
description: Three campgrounds with basic and hookup camping near Roaring River.
seasonal_notes: Campground 1 operates year-round; campgrounds 2 and 3 operate February 25 through October 31. Check official advisories before arrival.

name: Table Rock State Park Campgrounds
description: Two campgrounds on Table Rock Lake with basic and hookup sites.
seasonal_notes: Camping is available year-round; water and shower services vary in winter. Gates close at 10 p.m.

name: Devil's Den State Park Campground
description: Tent and hookup camping in Lee Creek Valley near Lake Devil.
seasonal_notes: Campground open year-round. Contact the park for horse-camp reservations.

name: Bull Shoals-White River State Park Campground
description: Tent and hookup camping beside the White River below Bull Shoals Dam. The camping entrance is in Lakeview, separate from the visitor center.
seasonal_notes: Campground open year-round; bathhouses operate March through November.
